title: GridSim v1 transformer.json
description: The two-winding transformers of the case, one record each. Optional file. Tap changers and boundaries refer to transformers by name. Member names are case-sensitive here (canonical camelCase spelling), although the v1 loader matches them ignoring case: the case editor refuses to save a non-canonical spelling until it is normalised (Q1, strict). Unknown members are refused, as the loader refuses them (R268). JSON null is refused everywhere: the loader reads null as absent, and the editor removes a member rather than writing null. Numeric ranges mirror the v2 network schema, so a v1 case the editor saves always projects to a valid v2 network. Rules a schema cannot express (bus references resolving, ZIP triples summing to 1, the [VERIFY] honesty rule) are the loader's.

transformer.title: Transformer
transformer.description: A two-winding transformer (v1 TransformerDto). Absent: r/x 0, tapRatio 1, phaseShiftDeg 0, ratingMva 0 (unrated), no dynamics class.

name.title: Name
name.description: Branch name; tap changers and boundaries find transformers by it. Absent: none.

rPu.title: Resistance (pu)
rPu.description: Series resistance, per unit on the case base. Absent: 0.

xPu.title: Reactance (pu)
xPu.description: Series reactance, per unit on the case base. Absent: 0.

ratingBMva.title: Short-term rating B (MVA)
ratingBMva.description: Short-term rating (MATPOWER RATE_B; N119, as transmission.json since F20). Used only when a contingency screen is asked to judge post-fault loading against rating B. Absent: 0 (not given; such a check then uses ratingMva).

ratingCMva.title: Emergency rating C (MVA)
ratingCMva.description: Emergency rating (MATPOWER RATE_C; N119, as transmission.json since F20). Used only when a contingency screen is asked to judge post-fault loading against rating C. Absent: 0 (not given; such a check then uses ratingMva).

dynamicsClass.title: Dynamics class
dynamicsClass.description: Name of a passive-plant asset class in asset-classes.json bound to this transformer. Absent: none.
